purpose: one source-continuous activity rejection gate for every empirical route-size candidate from the consumed indirect internal conversion screen

parent_result.candidate_set: all 20 empirical route-size candidates exactly as published with no additions or outcome-selected omissions

request.endpoint: GET https://api.binance.com/api/v3/ticker/24hr once for the complete current symbol population
request.retry_policy: none after a retained successful response
request.one_use_rule: do not change candidate membership activity thresholds or retained-capture freshness rules after access

retained_capture_freshness_gate.definition: count a symbol change when any displayed bid price bid quantity ask price or ask quantity differs from the preceding one of the 60 retained two-second full-book responses
retained_capture_freshness_gate.interpretation: supplementary stale-display rejection only and never proof of fill or quote age

rolling_activity_gate.required_ticker_window: all three exact symbols must have one valid current 24h ticker row
rolling_activity_gate.interpretation: activity rejection only and never proof that displayed capacity was executable sequentially

requires: parent route-size candidate passed every frozen fee rounding capacity residual stress recurrence and capture-level gate
all three exact symbols changed displayed top-of-book state at least five times in the retained capture
all three exact symbols report at least 100 trades in the one current 24-hour response
survivor_boundary.meaning: current independently testable organic-conversion route candidate only
survivor_boundary.next_evidence: one future independent non-overlapping prospective window using exact same-account fees and only an independently required organic conversion; no static-route or deployment claim

prohibited_shortcuts: promoting a route because it survived this activity gate
treating trade count or quote changes as fillability latency or sequential completion
dropping losing candidates or weakening thresholds after the response
requesting credentials placing orders or creating conversion volume
rerunning the same 24-hour activity gate on an unchanged mechanism
